tool.disposition_gate: enforcing and prefix-structured: after leading whitespace the disposition must begin with SAFETY_DISCHARGED followed by end-of-string or a non-word character (^\s*SAFETY_DISCHARGED\b); substring mentions, NOT_SAFETY_DISCHARGED and SAFETY_DISCHARGED_PENDING refuse with disposition-is-not-safety-discharged
